piece.headline: SUKRUT SURGES WITH THE WEEK'S BEST SCORE, TITLE RACE STAYS TIGHT
piece.standfirst: Sukrut posts the week's best score, but Aditya Dalal still leads the table by 3 points.
piece.big_picture: Aditya Dalal stays top and stretches his lead to 3 points. Sukrut had the best week in the league and still couldn't pass him. Anuj's Bench Boost brought nothing from the bench, so third place looks a long way off.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Atharva Kshirsagar left 28 points on the bench. The week's costliest team selection by miles. The dropped players did the scoring while the picked ones watched.
piece.one_to_watch: Aditya Dalal leads Sukrut by 3 points. Sukrut just had the week's best score, so if he repeats it and Dalal slips, the lead could flip at the top.

winners.name: Sukrut
winners.verdict: Brought in Tavernier and top-scored the league with 71. Smart move, big week. It still left him second, which must sting.

winners.name: Sujal
winners.verdict: Hall came in, the points followed and he climbed 4 places. Nice, tidy work. A proper skill week.

winners.name: Pruthviraj
winners.verdict: Pruthviraj made no chip play and no noise. The score still beat most of the league. Sneaky stuff.

losers.name: Aary
losers.verdict: João Pedro wore the armband and blanked. It happens to the best of us. Tough week, nothing more to it than that.

losers.name: Sahil Phadnis
losers.verdict: Bought Haaland and Belloumi, then left 10 points on the bench. The right idea, the wrong lineup.
